objectives.description: Extend acquire_scope_mutex to accept optional stale-window argument, write stale_sec file
Waiter branch reads holder-declared stale_sec with fallback
Register scope-acquire/scope-release in dispatch + usage string
No task-number citations in new comments

notes: Verified via .claude/scripts/task-lock.sh copy: scope-acquire prints token + creates specs/.scope-lock/{claimed_at,stale_sec,owner}; contended second acquire fails closed exit 2 within ~6.5s (5s wait loop + jq overhead); scope-release with correct token removes the mutex; scope-release with wrong token warns loudly and leaves mutex intact. Pre-existing acquire/heartbeat/release/check path regression-tested against a disposable scratch task dir (specs/999_scratch_lock_regression_test, removed after test) rather than task 882's own live lock, after an initial mistake where an early regression test's release call against task 882 (cmd_release is unconditional, no session-ownership check) deleted the live task-882 lock held by the orchestrating session; immediately restored via a fresh acquire with the correct session_id/operation/command before re-running the regression safely on the scratch dir.
